### VietLab v1.0.3 - Kiem soat toan dien, bao ve tien trinh & Tu dong nang cap Client

- Tu dong phat hien & nang cap Client: May con tu dong kiem tra phien ban khi ket noi Server va tu dong cai dat ngam ban moi nhat trong 3 giay.
- Tich hop bo cai Client vao Server: Server luon mang san bo cai dat Client chuan Inno Setup de phuc vu tai qua Cong thong tin LAN hoac lenh tu dong nang cap.
- Chan tat VietLab.Client qua Task Manager: Vo hieu hoa Task Manager (DisableTaskMgr) va bo sung Watchdog tu dong dong cac cong cu can thiep tien trinh.
- Khoa doc lap chuot & ban phim: Khoa phan cung nhap lieu kem thanh thong bao noi tren man hinh, van giu nguyen desktop de hoc sinh xem huong dan.
- Vo hieu hoa Startup tren may con: Tu dong don sach cac ung dung la khoi dong cung Windows tren may hoc sinh.
- Che do man hinh luon sang: Tu dong cau hinh Never Sleep (powercfg) giup man hinh khong bi tat va khong bi ngat ket noi mang.
